detailed_description: Strikethrough Text Generator creates various text decoration styles including strikethrough (t̶e̶x̶t̶), underline, crosshatch, and slash effects. Works on most social media platforms and messaging apps.
usage_steps: Enter your text in the input field
Click copy on your preferred style
usage1: Works on most social media platforms
usage2: Copy and paste the styled text anywhere
usage3: Some apps may not display all styles correctly
